description: This file contains the implementation of the MediaKeySessionTestBase class, which provides mock-based setup and utility functions for testing MediaKeySession behavior in a media key session management system. It includes methods for creating, destroying, and managing key sessions, as well as setting expectations for interactions with mocks.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing mock setup and utility functions for testing MediaKeySession interactions.

methods.name: MediaKeySessionTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects for testing.

methods.name: destroyKeySession
methods.description: Sets expectation for unregistering the client during key session destruction.

methods.name: expectCloseKeySession
methods.description: Sets expectations for closing a key session based on the key system.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Simulates generating a key request with specific init data.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread mock.
